item.title: Hezbollah’s Al-Manar TV says Israeli strike hit Beirut office
item.description: BEIRUT, Lebanon (AFP) : An Israeli strike hit the south Beirut office of Al-Manar TV, which is affiliated with Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah, the broadcaster said on Tuesday. Israel “targets the Al-Manar Channel building in the Haret Hreik area,” Al-Manar wrote on Telegram, referring to a part of south Beirut.
